general_information.Syllabus Name: Brand Identity Design_Thiết kế nhận diện thương hiệu
general_information.Description: Description:The objective of this course is to equip students with basic knowledge of Branding and Brand Identity Design: Basic theory of Branding in the digital age and artificial intelligence; Methods of market research and customer understanding; Process of brand building, operation and management of brand identity; Building appropriate brand promotion strategies. Objectives: The course will prepare students with knowledge of the branding process and brand management. Skills in designing a brand identity system and managing this design system according to standards on many different media; The course will help students perfect a variety of skills in researching branding projects and applying research to problem solving; The course helps students understand the trends in brand identity design and choose the appropriate artistic direction. Teaching method: Self-study of documents, Under the guidance of lecturers, Research and analysis of real projects, Practice of individual exercises combined with group exercises, students will be equipped with knowledge and skills to build and perfect a brand identity system.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use personal laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website FLM (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course. - Wacom or digital drawing tools is suggested but not required
general_information.Tools: 1. The school prepare: (Installed) - Classroom with chairs, desks, large monitor with HDMI connection for demo/presentation - Internet connection. 2. Student prepare: - Note/Sketchbooks, pens and pencils - Laptop for graphic design with Adobe Creative apps installed

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the basic knowledge and processes of branding and brand identity design.
Understand, plan and apply research methods in the process of branding and brand identity design.
Analyze, evaluate and manage branding and brand identity design projects.
Have basic experience in applying specialized design tools to design logos and brand identity systems.
Have skills to use a variety of technology tools for creating new brand or rebranding.
Demonstrate professional behavior in studying and working with people in an educational and cultural environment.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Assignment 1: Brand Theory & Market Research Skill
assessments.Note: - Assessment criteria proposed by the teacher during the teaching process. Groups (4-5 students) - The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Market research methodology, Data collection and analysis (55%) and Slide presentation and presentation skills (15%), ability to apply AI tools (15%) to research stages, ability to explain and answer questions from the assessor (15%) - Students are allowed to use AI tools in the research orientation stages, drafting the interview question system. Lecturers check the use of AI by the prompt history on the tool. If necessary, lecturers can ask students to take screenshots and attach them in the report.

- Assessment criteria proposed by the teacher during the teaching process. Groups (2-3 students) . If students work individual, they need to consider the amount of topics and the amount of work. -The evaluation will consider the following criteria : Quality of market research, target customer research and product (or service) (55%) and Presentation slides and presentation skills (15%), ability to apply AI tools (15%) to research stages,and ability to explain and answer questions from the assessor (15%) - Students are allowed to use AI tools in the research orientation stages, drafting the interview question system. Lecturers check the use of AI by the prompt history on the tool. If necessary, lecturers can ask students to take screenshots and attach them in the report, or other solutions to clarify the work completion process.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Assignment 3: Logo design for Project research
assessments.Note: Individual The evaluation will consider the following criteria: art direction research, logo development and completion (70%) and Logo presentation (15%), ability to explain and answer questions from the judges (15%)

- Groups (2-3 students). If students work individually, it is necessary to consider the volume and scale of the project to meet the standards of a basic brand identity. -The evaluation will consider the following criteria: Brand identity system that is consistent with the brand's needs and purposes, Appropriate aesthetics, Ability to manage graphic elements throughout and consistently throughout the final project (65%) and project showcase (25%), Ability to explain and answer questions from the jury (10%)
Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions.
